feeds.title: Wordplay Magazine
feeds.description: Wordplay Magazine covers hip hop from the UK including all elements of the culture from Rap, Soul, and Jazz music. Wordplay is a printed publication and digital, as well as a daily updated blog, monthly podcast, and live session videos. The magazine's mission is simple: to share the latest and best music with you.

feeds.description: Get hip to the latest rap and hip-hop news and releases coming out of the United Kingdom. Here you can get articles on the latest music releases by different artists, insides into their personal life, what are they working on, and many more!

feeds.title: Underground Sound
feeds.description: Underground Sound is a global media hub that offers readers, listeners, and professionals exclusive access to global underground music, events, and culture. Based in Malta, we are an international media outlet reporting on all spectrums of underground music, underreported festivals, and juicy music industry insights.

feeds.description: The Hip-hop Thursday section delivers all the best hip-hop tracks by different artists. She Makes Music is a blog that focuses on the best new music made by female and non-binary musicians from all around the world.

feeds.title: Britishhiphop.co.uk
feeds.description: Britishhiphop.co.uk is a music entertainment and marketing company based in London, UK. Founded in 1996, we have become one of the longest-established and respected Hip Hop music websites in the UK, working with artists from all of the home nations and overseas.

feeds.title: Reverb Music
feeds.description: The reflection of sound. News, reviews, features, and interviews.

feeds.title: The 273
feeds.description: The 273 is here to bring you the bangers. Keeping that faint heartbeat alive since April 2010, we've been sporadically posting as and when we want to, live from the UK for over ten years.

feeds.title: Mic Cheque » UK Rap
feeds.description: Mic Cheque works towards bridging UK rap and hip hop. An online publication that bridges the gap between British and American hip hop. From a review blog, Mic Cheque has grown into a viral media network, providing hip-hop fans with unique social media content, thoughtful analysis, and coverage of the latest up-and-coming talent.
